short: Boosting the Pseudocapacitive and High Mass-Loaded Lithium/S
title: Boosting the Pseudocapacitive and High Mass-Loaded Lithium/Sodium Storage through Bonding Polyoxometalate Nanoparticles on MXene Nanosheets

lanes.label: Classical tools
lanes.sub: collapsed to one node per state

states.title: Hypothesis and design
states.head: Polyoxometalate anodes give high initial capacity but fade fast and lose capacity at high current, blocking Li/Na storage use. Chemically bonding POM nanoparticles onto conductive MXene nanosheets should give pseudocapacitive, stable, high-mass-loaded Li/Na storage.
states.detail: Absorbed: n1 (HYP/need), n2 (HYP/hypothesis), n3 (DES/base_system), n4 (DES/modification), n5 (PRC/synthesis), n15 (DES/down_select)

states.title: Structure state
states.head: MF POM nanoparticles densely and uniformly dispersed on and between MXene nanosheets (sandwich-like stack). MF POM particles grown on the MXene are ~10-20 nm across.
states.detail: Absorbed: n6 (STR/microstructure/distribution), n7 (STR/microstructure/feature_size), n8 (STR/interface). Premises: A shift of metal core levels to lower binding energy on hybridising indicates electron donation/chemical interaction with the support

states.title: Property state and mechanisms
states.head: Charge storage in MF POMs/MXenes is dominated by the capacitive (pseudocapacitive) contribution for both Li and Na. Composite anode keeps a large share of its capacity at high current and recovers it when current returns to 0.1 A/g.
states.detail: Absorbed: n10 (PRP/value), n11 (PRP/value), n12 (PRP/value), n13 (MEC/pathway). Premises: Power-law i = a v^b: b = 0.5 means diffusion-controlled, b = 1 means surface (capacitive) controlled storage

states.title: Performance state
states.head: Electrode keeps most of its specific capacity up to 6 mg/cm2 loading, giving areal capacities of ~2.2 (Li) and ~1.4 (Na) mAh/cm2. MF POMs/MXenes//AC LIC delivers ~165 Wh/kg at 0.1 kW/kg and ~66 Wh/kg at ~6 kW/kg.

states.title: Conclusion
states.head: Bonding POM nanoparticles on MXene yields pseudocapacitive, stable, high-loading Li/Na anodes that enable high-energy, high-power LIC and SIC

nodes.title: evidence, F3, F5
nodes.head: Li cycling: capacity ~350 -> ~300 mAh/g at 1.0 A/g and ~265 -> ~210 mAh/g at 4.0 A/g over 1000 cycles, CE ~100%. Na cycling: after an early drop, ~215 -> ~178 mAh/g at 1.0 A/g and ~160 -> ~122 at 3.0 A/g over 1000 cycles
nodes.solves: Composite anode holds its capacity over 1000 cycles at 1-4 A/g for both Li and Na
nodes.note: F3b (0.1 A/g, 100 cycles): ~620 -> ~470 mAh/g, no POM reference trace in the panel y-axis is labelled 'Energy density (Wh kg-1)' although this is a half-cell capacity plot; 3.0 A/g retention reads ~76%, text says 80.6%. F5b shows no bare-POM trace
nodes.detail: o13: Li cycling: capacity ~350 -> ~300 mAh/g at 1.0 A/g and ~265 -> ~210 mAh/g at 4.0 A/g over 1000 cycles, CE ~100%; o23: Na cycling: after an early drop, ~215 -> ~178 mAh/g at 1.0 A/g and ~160 -> ~122 at 3.0 A/g over 1000 cycles
nodes.necessity_reason: Only figure-backed support with image_support shown for n12 (o13).

nodes.title: ECHEM:galvanostatic, F3, F5
nodes.head: Li rate test: ~540 mAh/g at 0.1 A/g falling to ~200 mAh/g at 6.0 A/g, ~515 mAh/g on return to 0.1 A/g. Capacity retained at 6.0 vs 0.1 A/g is ~37% (200/540), not the 51% the text states.
nodes.solves: Composite anode keeps a large share of its capacity at high current and recovers it when current returns to 0.1 A/g
nodes.op: cross check consistency, read characteristic point, replot derived series
nodes.note: text: 'capacitance retention of 51% with a 60-fold increase in current density'
nodes.detail: o14: Li rate test: ~540 mAh/g at 0.1 A/g falling to ~200 mAh/g at 6.0 A/g, ~515 mAh/g on return to 0.1 A/g; o15: Capacity retained at 6.0 vs 0.1 A/g is ~37% (200/540), not the 51% the text states; o22: Na rate test: ~308 mAh/g at 0.1 A/g falling to ~110 mAh/g at 4.0 A/g, ~288 mAh/g on return
nodes.inner_audit: o15: text: 'capacitance retention of 51% with a 60-fold increase in current density'

nodes.title: ECHEM:CV, F5
nodes.head: Na CV at 2 mV/s: composite loop encloses a larger area than either MF POMs or MXenes
nodes.solves: Conductive MXene network plus small bonded POM particles give fast charge transfer and short ion paths, so surface redox dominates
nodes.note: contrast F3a (Li): bare MF POM loop is larger than the composite's (cathodic to ~-2.9 vs ~-1.5 A/g), which the text concedes
